# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 7 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Stroke — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the paper value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | paper | ink | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #e9e4d8 | #1f1e1c | Raised cards, chart panels, chat bubbles on bg. Never a third colour, only a step of the ground. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the paper value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | paper | ink | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #141414 | #f4f1ea | Primary text and solid shapes on bg or surface. |
| `ink-muted` | #5f5c56 | #a29e95 | Secondary text on bg: sources, dates, labels, axis text. At least 4.5:1 on bg in both themes. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--brand-paper);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the paper value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | paper | ink | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brand-paper` | #f4f1ea | #f4f1ea | The locked paper colour. Fixed in both themes; use when you need the literal brand paper (e.g. a paper card sliding over talking-head footage). |
| `brand-ink` | #141414 | #141414 | The locked ink colour. Fixed in both themes; the literal brand ink. |
| `signal` | #e2432a | #e2432a | The locked signal red. ONE use per frame: the key phrase, the key number, or a pen mark. Text in signal only at 60px and above (contrast vs paper is about 3.7:1, large-text only). |
| `bg` | #f4f1ea | #141414 | Frame background. Paper theme is the default; ink theme for heavier moments and variety. |
| `line` | #1414141f | #f4f1ea24 | Grid hairlines and construction lines. Structure you feel more than see. |
| `line-strong` | #14141466 | #f4f1ea66 | Rules, dividers, diagram connectors, chart axes. |
| `signal-marker` | #e2432a47 | #e2432a47 | Highlighter swipe behind ink text. Keeps text ink-coloured and readable while the red does the pointing. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-display-xl);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 132px / 1 | 600 | `sans` | Hook titles: one short line, 3-6 words. Sizes are at the native 1080px-wide canvas. |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 104px / 1.02 | 600 | `sans` | Section titles and two-line hooks. |
| `headline` | `.headline`, `--text-headline` | 80px / 1.05 | 500 | `sans` | Carousel slide headlines and in-video key lines. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 60px / 1.15 | 500 | `sans` | Diagram nodes, chart titles, lower-third names. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 44px / 1.35 | 400 | `sans` | Supporting text. The smallest size for anything meant to be read in a reel. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 32px / 1.2 | 500 | `sans` | Numbered labels, axis labels, tags. Floor size: nothing smaller than 32px on a 1080 canvas. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 32px / 1.3 | 400 | `sans` | Source lines and fine print, in ink-muted. |
| `accent-italic` | `.accent-italic`, `--text-accent-italic` | 104px / 1.02 | 400 | `serif` | The signature: one key phrase inside a sans headline, in Gambetta italic, usually in signal. Match the size of the headline it sits in. |
| `quote` | `.quote`, `--text-quote` | 64px / 1.2 | 400 | `serif` | Quotes from people, companies, courts. Gambetta regular, ink. |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 8px | Tight gaps: icon to text, number to unit. |
| `space-2` | 16px | Label to value, line to line in a block. |
| `space-3` | 24px | Grid gutter; gap between related items. |
| `space-4` | 40px | Card padding; gap between groups. |
| `space-5` | 64px | Side margin of every frame; gap between sections. |
| `space-6` | 96px | Large separation; diagram node spacing. |
| `space-7` | 144px | Hero breathing room around a single hook or number. |
| `safe-top` | 250px | Reels: keep text below this (username and audio row sit above). |
| `safe-bottom` | 420px | Reels: keep text above this (caption, buttons and progress bar sit below). |
| `safe-right` | 160px | Reels: keep text left of this from the right edge (like, comment, share column). |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-0) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-0` | 0 | Default. Frames, cards, chart bars, diagram nodes: square and editorial. |
| `radius-sm` | 8px | Small tags and pills only. |
| `radius-lg` | 28px | Chat bubbles and phone/app screenshots, so they read as UI, not as brand shapes. |

## Stroke

### Use

```css
/* var(--stroke-hair) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stroke-hair` | 2px | Grid lines and construction lines (with line). |
| `stroke-rule` | 4px | Rules, connectors, chart axes (with line-strong or ink). |
| `stroke-pen` | 10px | Hand-drawn pen marks in signal: underline, circle, arrow, strike, tick. |
